title: Bob Denard: The Mercenary Who Ruled the Comoros (English Listening Practice)
speaker: Alastair Budge

sentences.en: Hello, hello, hello, and welcome to English Learning for Curious Minds, by Leonardo English, the show where you can listen to fascinating stories and learn weird and wonderful things about the world at the same time as improving your English.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听由 Leonardo English 制作的 English Learning for Curious Minds。在这档节目里，你可以一边听引人入胜的故事、了解世界上各种离奇而精彩的事物，一边提高你的英语水平。

sentences.en: I'm Alastair Budge, and today we are going to the Comoros Islands, a tiny, remote archipelago in the Indian Ocean which became the unlikely setting for one of the strangest stories of the twentieth century.
sentences.zh: 我是 Alastair Budge。今天我们要前往科摩罗群岛，这是位于印度洋上的一个微小而偏远的的群岛，它却出人意料地成为了20世纪最怪异故事之一的发生地。

sentences.en: It's the story of a French mercenary who staged four coups in the same country, converted to Islam, took a new name, built a farm, was shot in the head twice, controlled the entire country from behind the scenes for over a decade, but then it all went terribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于一名法国雇佣兵的故事：他在同一个国家发动了四次政变，改信伊斯兰教，改了新名字，建了一座农场，头部两次中弹，在幕后控制了整个国家长达十多年，但最终一切都陷入了彻底的灾难。

sentences.en: OK then, let's not waste a minute and get right into it.
sentences.zh: 好了，那我们事不宜迟，立刻进入正题。

sentences.en: I'm going to go out on a limb and say that I imagine you might not know all that much about the Comoros Islands.
sentences.zh: 我冒昧猜想一下，你可能对科摩罗群岛并不怎么了解。

sentences.en: If you could place them on a map, you're probably ahead of most people.
sentences.zh: 如果你能在地图上指出来它的位置，那你大概就已经领先大多数人了。

sentences.en: They are the small group of islands in the Indian Ocean, about halfway between Madagascar and Mozambique, off the eastern coast of Africa.
sentences.zh: 它们是印度洋上的一组小岛，位于非洲东海岸外，大约处于马达加斯加和莫桑比克的中间位置。

sentences.en: They are pretty small, roughly the size of London, and have this volcanic landscape: steep peaks, dense jungle, and black lava fields.
sentences.zh: 它们面积相当小，大致和伦敦差不多大，拥有火山地貌：陡峭的山峰、茂密的丛林和黑色的熔岩平原。

sentences.en: Culturally, they have been shaped by centuries of African, Arab, and French influence.
sentences.zh: 在文化上，它们几个世纪以来一直受到非洲、阿拉伯和法国的影响。

sentences.en: Traders and settlers landed and made their bases over the years, and in 1886, France took formal control of the islands.
sentences.zh: 多年来，商人和平民定居者陆续登陆并建立基地。1886年，法国正式控制了这些岛屿。

sentences.en: It would govern them as part of its overseas empire for nearly ninety years.
sentences.zh: 作为其海外帝国的一部分，法国管辖了这些岛屿近九十年。

sentences.en: But by the early 1970s, independence was clearly coming, and this corner of the Indian Ocean was about to become the setting for something far less peaceful.
sentences.zh: 但到了1970年代初，独立大势已不可阻挡，而印度洋的这片角落即将成为一场远没那么和平的剧目的舞台。

sentences.en: In 1973, the French government and the Comorian leaders had reached an agreement: there would be a referendum the following year.
sentences.zh: 1973年，法国政府与科摩罗领导人达成协议：将在次年举行全民公投。

sentences.en: And sure enough, the referendum was held in 1974, with an overwhelming majority voting for independence.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，公投于1974年举行，绝大多数人投票支持独立。

sentences.en: But one of the four islands, Mayotte, did not vote for independence, instead preferring to remain part of France.
sentences.zh: 但是四个岛屿之一的马约特岛并没有投票支持独立，而是选择继续保留为法国的一部分。

sentences.en: This kicked off new discussions, more complications that we don't need to go into for this story, but the thing to understand is this: France was still dragging its feet, and the head of the government under the territorial system, a man named Ahmed Abdallah, decided he had had enough.
sentences.zh: 这引发了新的讨论和更多复杂的纠纷，在这个故事里我们不必深究，但关键需要理解的是：法国仍在拖泥带水，而领地制度下的政府首脑、一个名为 Ahmed Abdallah 的人决定不再忍受。

sentences.en: On the 6th of July 1975, he stood before the Comorian parliament and declared independence, unilaterally, without waiting for France's blessing.
sentences.zh: 1975年7月6日，他站在科摩罗议会面前，单方面宣布独立，根本没有等待法国的批准。

sentences.en: France was not best pleased. It didn't immediately recognise the new country, and it withdrew most of its financial support.
sentences.zh: 法国对此非常不满。它没有立即承认这个新国家，并且撤走了大部分财政援助。

sentences.en: And Ahmed Abdallah, well, he didn't last a month.
sentences.zh: 至于 Ahmed Abdallah，嗯，他连一个月都没撑过去。

sentences.en: After 27 days, he had been booted out of office in a coup led by a French mercenary called Robert Denard.
sentences.zh: 27天后，在一场由名为 Robert Denard 的法国雇佣兵领导的政变中，他被赶下了台。

sentences.en: Now, we will come to the coup, and the other coups, in a minute, but first let me paint you a picture of Robert Denard.
sentences.zh: 我们等会儿再讲这次政变以及后面的其他政变，但首先让我来为你勾勒一下 Robert Denard 这个人。

sentences.en: He was born in 1929, in a small village in the Gironde, in southwest France.
sentences.zh: 他于1929年出生在法国西南部吉伦特省的一个小村庄。

sentences.en: He was not from a military family, and he had no formal military education to speak of.
sentences.zh: 他并非出身于军人家庭，也谈不上接受过什么正式的军事教育。

sentences.en: But what he did have, from a young age, was a taste for action and a very flexible relationship with the idea of loyalty.
sentences.zh: 但他从小就拥有的，是对行动的热衷，以及对“忠诚”这一概念极为灵活的态度。

sentences.en: He joined the French Navy as a young man, and then like hundreds of thousands of other young French men, served during the First Indochina War.
sentences.zh: 年轻时他加入了法国海军，然后像成千上万的其他法国年轻人一样，在第一次印度支那战争期间服役。

sentences.en: So far, nothing particularly outrageous.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，还没有什么特别离谱的事。

sentences.en: He had clearly started to go down a slightly different path, however, as he was convicted of plotting to assassinate the French Prime Minister in 1954, and sentenced to 14 months in jail.
sentences.zh: 然而，他显然开始走上了一条截然不同的道路：1954年，他因策划暗杀法国总理而被判有罪，获刑14个月。

sentences.en: On his release, he tried his hand at a more conventional life, becoming a salesman, but it wasn't for him.
sentences.zh: 出狱后，他尝试过一种更常规的生活，做了一名推销员，但这并不适合他。

sentences.en: Life outside of Metropolitan France, it seemed, offered more excitement, more opportunities for adventure.
sentences.zh: 看来，法国本土之外的生活能提供更多的刺激和更多的冒险机会。

sentences.en: He joined the colonial police in Morocco.
sentences.zh: 他加入了摩洛哥的殖民地警察部队。

sentences.en: And by the early 1960s, he had found his way into a very different kind of work.
sentences.zh: 到了1960年代初，他寻觅到了另一种截然不同的工作。

sentences.en: The Congo was falling apart. Belgium had granted the Congo independence in 1960, and within weeks the country was in crisis.
sentences.zh: 当时刚果正在走向崩溃。比利时于1960年给予刚果独立，但在短短几周内，该国就陷入了危机。

sentences.en: Separatist movements, rival governments, a military that could barely hold itself together, and a prime minister who had been assassinated with the involvement of both Belgian and American intelligence.
sentences.zh: 分离主义运动、互相敌对的政府、摇摇欲坠的军队，以及一位在比利时和美国情报部门参与下被暗杀的总理。

sentences.en: Into this chaos came a new kind of professional.
sentences.zh: 在这片混乱之中，一种新型的“专业人士”粉墨登场了。

sentences.en: The mercenary. And of course, Robert Denard.
sentences.zh: 那就是雇佣兵。当然，还有 Robert Denard。

sentences.en: He arrived in 1961, after being recruited by a fellow Frenchman to fight for the secessionists.
sentences.zh: 1961年，他在被一名法国同胞招募去为分离主义分子作战后抵达了那里。

sentences.en: He was thirty-two years old, and it seemed that he had found his calling.
sentences.zh: 那时他三十二岁，似乎找到了属于自己的天职。

sentences.en: Over the next fifteen years he fought in the Congo, in Biafra during the Nigerian Civil War, in Yemen, Benin, Chad and Angola.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的十五年里，他在刚果、尼日利亚内战期间的比亚法拉、也门、贝宁、乍得和安哥拉四处作战。

sentences.en: He organised coups, he trained militias, he led men into battle across half a continent.
sentences.zh: 他组织政变，训练民兵，带领手下在半个大洲的土地上冲锋陷阵。

sentences.en: There is little record of the details of what he actually did, for obvious reasons, but given how long he did it for, how in demand he was, and that he survived for so long, he must have been pretty good at it.
sentences.zh: 出于显而易见的原因，关于他具体做了什么的详细记录极少，但考虑到他干这一行的时长、市场对他的需求，以及他竟然活了这么久，他在这方面肯定相当精通。

sentences.en: And almost everywhere he went, he had something he could count on: the quiet backing, the implicit approval, of France.
sentences.zh: 而且几乎无论他走到哪里，他都有可以倚仗的后台：来自法国的默默支持和默许。

sentences.en: This was part of the French government's system of Françafrique.
sentences.zh: 这是法国政府“法属非洲”体系的一部分。

sentences.en: The idea was simple: France would maintain its influence over its former African colonies not through direct rule, since that era was over, but through money, intelligence, and when necessary, through men like Bob Denard.
sentences.zh: 其核心理念很简单：法国将维持对其前非洲殖民地的影响力，不再通过直接统治（因为那个时代已经结束了），而是通过资金、情报，以及在必要时通过像 Bob Denard 这样的人。

sentences.en: And the mastermind of this, or rather the man with a direct line to both the French President and a vast network of informants, fixers, businessmen, and mercenaries, was called Jacques Foccart.
sentences.zh: 而这一体系的幕后策划者，或者更准确地说是那个能直通法国总统并掌握着由情报员、掮客、商人及雇佣兵组成的庞大网络的人，名叫 Jacques Foccart。

sentences.en: He was reportedly known as Monsieur Afrique, or Mr Africa.
sentences.zh: 据报道，他被称为“非洲先生”（Monsieur Afrique，或 Mr Africa）。

sentences.en: Whenever something needed to be done in Africa, Foccart knew who to call.
sentences.zh: 每当在非洲需要办什么事时，Jacques Foccart 都知道该找谁。

sentences.en: Importantly, this was always at an arm's length from the official government.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，这一切始终与官方政府保持着距离。

sentences.en: Always with plausible deniability.
sentences.zh: 始终保持着“可合理的否认性”。

sentences.en: And Bob Denard was one of Foccart's most reliable instruments.
sentences.zh: 而 Bob Denard 正是 Jacques Foccart 最可靠的工具之一。

sentences.en: Now, Denard was not especially ideological, as will become apparent.
sentences.zh: 正如接下来大家会看到的，Bob Denard 并没有特别强烈的意识形态。

sentences.en: He fought for whoever was paying, as long as the politics broadly aligned with French interests.
sentences.zh: 只要政治方向大致符合法国的利益，谁给钱他就替谁卖命。

sentences.en: What he wanted was action, autonomy, and money.
sentences.zh: 他所追求的是刺激、自主权和金钱。

sentences.en: For most of his life, he had all three. And even when things went wrong, he rarely paid the price.
sentences.zh: me在他人生的大部分时间里，这三样他兼而有之。而且即使事情搞砸了，他也很少付出代价。

sentences.en: He was seriously injured four times, and was shot in the head twice.
sentences.zh: 他曾四次身受重伤，头部两次中弹。

sentences.en: But he survived. In January 1977, he led a coup attempt in Benin that collapsed after three hours.
sentences.zh: 但他活了下来。1977年1月，他在贝宁领导了一场政变企图，但三小时后就崩溃了。

sentences.en: A French court later sentenced him in absentia to five years' imprisonment, and a Beninese court gave him the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 法国法院后来缺席判处他五年监禁，贝宁法院则判处他死刑。

sentences.en: But neither sentence troubled him particularly.
sentences.zh: 但这两项判决都没怎么困扰到他。

sentences.en: And this was a theme in his life; by the time he got into trouble, if he was ever caught and sentenced, he would be long gone.
sentences.zh: 而这也是他一生中的常态：等到他招来麻烦，就算被抓住并判刑，他也早就溜之大吉了。

sentences.en: By 1975, he was forty-six years old, with bullet scars dotted over his body and a mercenary 's career already behind him that most soldiers couldn't match in two lifetimes.
sentences.zh: 到了1975年，他四十六岁，身上布满了枪伤疤痕，而他已经拥有的雇佣兵生涯是大多数士兵两辈子都难以企及的。

sentences.en: Then someone called him about the Comoros.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，有人给他打来了关于科摩罗的电话。

sentences.en: So, it is the 3rd of August 1975. Ahmed Abdallah has been president of the Comoros for twenty-seven days.
sentences.zh: 时间来到1975年8月3日。Ahmed Abdallah 担任科摩罗总统才刚满二十七天。

sentences.en: Bob Denard arrives with a small group of mercenaries and removes him from power.
sentences.zh: Bob Denard 带着一小队雇佣兵赶到，将他赶下了台。

sentences.en: The operation is almost comically swift.
sentences.zh: 这次行动迅速得近乎荒诞。

sentences.en: Abdallah is put on a plane to Paris. His government is dissolved.
sentences.zh: Ahmed Abdallah 被塞上一架飞往巴黎的飞机。他的政府被解散。

sentences.en: The whole thing is over before most Comorians have understood what has happened.
sentences.zh: 在大多数科摩罗人还没明白发生了什么之前，整件事就已经结束了。

sentences.en: Denard has been hired by a coalition of opposition political parties called the United National Front, six groups united mainly in wanting Abdallah gone.
sentences.zh: Bob Denard 是被一个名为“统一民族阵线”的反对党联盟雇佣的，这个联盟由六个组织组成，联合起来的主要目的就是想让 Ahmed Abdallah 下台。

sentences.en: Their man, a figure named Said Mohamed Jaffar, is installed as president.
sentences.zh: 他们的人，一个叫 Said Mohamed Jaffar 的人物，被扶上了总统宝座。

sentences.en: He lasts five months. The problem is that the United National Front was always a loose arrangement.
sentences.zh: 他只撑了五个月。问题在于，“统一民族阵线”本来就是一个松散的联盟。

sentences.en: Among its members is a more radical faction, led by a socialist named Ali Soilih.
sentences.zh: 在其成员中，有一个由名叫 Ali Soilih 的社会主义者领导的更为激进的派系。

sentences.en: Soilih has ideas. Very radical ideas, and no interest in sharing power with Jaffar, whom he considers too moderate, too willing to appease France.
sentences.zh: Ali Soilih 很有想法。非常激进的想法，而且他根本不想与 Said Mohamed Jaffar 共享权力，因为他认为后者太温和，太急于向法国妥协。

sentences.en: In January 1976, Soilih pushes Jaffar aside in another internal coup.
sentences.zh: 1976年1月，Ali Soilih 在另一场内部政变中把 Said Mohamed Jaffar 排挤到了一边。

sentences.en: And France cuts what little financial support it has left.
sentences.zh: 法国也随之切断了所剩无几的财政援助。

sentences.en: And Ali Soilih, well he is an unconventional leader in almost every sense.
sentences.zh: 至于 Ali Soilih，嗯，在几乎所有意义上，他都是一位极不寻常的领导人。

sentences.en: In one of his first acts, he orders the burning of the French colonial archives, a dramatic, symbolic rejection of the old order.
sentences.zh: 在他最早采取的行动之一中，他下令烧毁法国殖民地档案，以此戏剧性且极具象征意味地摒弃旧秩序。

sentences.en: He nationalises land. He promotes the removal of the veil among women.
sentences.zh: 他将土地收归国有。他推行女性摘除面纱。

sentences.en: He legalises cannabis, a drug he is personally a heavy user of.
sentences.zh: 他将大麻合法化，而他自己就是大麻的重度使用者。

sentences.en: And he creates a youth militia. He calls them the Moissy.
sentences.zh: 他还创建了一支青年民兵组织，称他们为“Moissy”。

sentences.en: They are teenagers, trained by Tanzanian military advisers and armed with AK-47 rifles.
sentences.zh: 他们都是十几岁的青少年，由坦桑尼亚军事顾问训练，配备着 AK-47 步枪。

sentences.en: He lowers the voting age to fourteen. He is a big fan of Chairman Mao, and this is his version of Mao's Red Guards, a cultural revolution in miniature, on three small volcanic islands in the Indian Ocean.
sentences.zh: 他把投票年龄降到了十四岁。他是毛主席的崇拜者，而这就是他版本的“红卫兵”——在印度洋的三个小火山岛上上演的微缩版“文化大革命”。

sentences.en: The Moissy, as you might imagine, do not cover themselves in glory.
sentences.zh: 正如你所能想象的那样，“Moissy”民兵并没有建立什么光彩的功勋。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Soilih is losing his grip on reality.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，Ali Soilih 正在逐渐失去理智。

sentences.en: He is drinking heavily. He is using drugs.
sentences.zh: 他酗酒，吸毒。

sentences.en: And he has begun consulting a witchdoctor for advice on matters of state.
sentences.zh: 他甚至开始向巫医咨询国家大事的建议。

sentences.en: And this witchdoctor has some bad news for him: he tells Soilih that he will be overthrown by a white man with a black dog.
sentences.zh: 而这位巫医给了他一个坏消息：巫医告诉 Ali Soilih，他将被一个带着一条黑狗的白人推翻。

sentences.en: Now, were I the sort of person who believed in prophecies from witchdoctors, I think I'd probably focus on the man rather than the dog part.
sentences.zh: 要是我这种会相信巫医预言的人，我觉得我大概会把注意力放在“人”身上，而不是“狗”身上。

sentences.en: Soilih, however, seemed more concerned about the canine aspect.
sentences.zh: 然而，Ali Soilih 似乎对犬类方面更为关切。

sentences.en: He orders a campaign to kill every single dog on the Comoros Islands.
sentences.zh: 他下令发起一场运动，屠杀科摩罗群岛上的每一条狗。

sentences.en: The islands are scoured. Dogs are found and killed in large numbers.
sentences.zh: 岛屿被彻底搜查，大量的狗被找到并处死。

sentences.en: It does not, as you might imagine, resolve the underlying problem.
sentences.zh: 如你所想，这并没有解决根本问题。

sentences.en: And by 1978, the islands are in a pretty poor place: economically broken, starved of French support, and struggling to maintain any semblance of public order.
sentences.zh: 到了1978年，这些岛屿陷入了相当糟糕的境地：经济崩溃，缺乏法国援助，连维持最起码的公共秩序都举步维艰。

sentences.en: Ahmed Abdallah, who has been living in Paris and plotting his return, he decides now is the time to take his country back.
sentences.zh: 一直住在巴黎策划重返政坛的 Ahmed Abdallah 决定，现在是夺回自己国家的时机了。

sentences.en: And the man he wants to help him is Bob Denard, the very same Bob Denard who removed him from power back in 1975.
sentences.zh: 而他希望协助他的人正是 Bob Denard——也就是1975年把它赶下台的那同一个 Bob Denard。

sentences.en: Fortunately for Abdallah, Bob Denard is more interested in getting paid than in holding a grudge, and he is more than happy to oblige.
sentences.zh: 对 Ahmed Abdallah 来说幸运的是，Bob Denard 对拿钱比记仇更感兴趣，非常乐意效劳。

sentences.en: In May 1978, in the dead of night, a boat arrives off the coast of Grande Comore, the largest of the Comoros Islands.
sentences.zh: 1978年5月的一天深夜，一艘船驶抵科摩罗群岛最大的岛屿大科摩罗岛海岸外。

sentences.en: Denard steps ashore with fifty men, most of them former French paratroopers.
sentences.zh: Bob Denard 带着五十名手下登岸，其中大部分是法国前伞兵。

sentences.en: He even, according to one report, brings a black dog with him, ensuring that the witchdoctor 's prophecy will come true.
sentences.zh: 据一份报告称，他甚至还随身带了一条黑狗，确保巫医的预言应验。

sentences.en: The operation takes a matter of hours. Soilih's forces collapse almost without a fight, and Soilih is placed under house arrest.
sentences.zh: 行动只用了几个小时。Ali Soilih 的军队几乎未作抵抗便瓦解了，Ali Soilih 本人被软禁起来。

sentences.en: Sixteen days later, however, he is shot dead, reportedly while trying to escape, although few people believe it.
sentences.zh: 然而十六天后，他被枪杀，据报道是在企图逃跑时被击毙的，尽管几乎没人相信这种说法。

sentences.en: Ahmed Abdallah is reinstated as president.
sentences.zh: Ahmed Abdallah 重新出任总统。

sentences.en: And as for Bob Denard, well, something surprising happens.
sentences.zh: 至于 Bob Denard，嗯，令人惊讶的事情发生了。

sentences.en: You might have thought this was just another contract for Bob Denard, and that he would be on the first plane out, waiting for his phone to ring and off on the next mission.
sentences.zh: 你可能以为这只是 Bob Denard 的又一次雇佣合同，他会坐上最快的一班飞机离开，等待下一次电话响起并奔赴下一个任务。

sentences.en: No. Denard does not go home. He stays. He becomes a Comorian citizen.
sentences.zh: 不。Bob Denard 没有回家。他留了下来。他成为了科摩罗公民。

sentences.en: He converts to Islam. He takes a new name: Said Moustapha M'Hadjou.
sentences.zh: 他改信伊斯兰教，取了个新名字：Said Moustapha M'Hadjou。

sentences.en: He marries a Comorian woman. Then another.
sentences.zh: 他娶了一位科摩罗女性。接着又娶了一位。

sentences.en: And another. By the end, he will have seven wives and eight children.
sentences.zh: 然后又一位。到最后，他一共拥有七位妻子和八个孩子。

sentences.en: He builds a farm. 1,800 acres of volcanic land, growing crops, raising livestock.
sentences.zh: 他建了一座农场。1800英亩的火山土地，种植农作物，饲养家畜。

sentences.en: He becomes, by all accounts, a genuine farmer, someone who gets up early and knows his land and takes pride in it.
sentences.zh: 据各方说法，他成了一名真正的农民，一个起早贪黑、熟悉自己的土地并以此为荣的人。

sentences.en: There is more to this, though. He has also been given command of the Presidential Guard, an elite 500-man unit.
sentences.zh: 不过，事情远不止于此。他还获得了总统卫队的指挥权，这是一支由500人组成的精锐部队。

sentences.en: In practical terms, this means he has military control over the country.
sentences.zh: 在实际意义上，这意味着他掌握了该国的军事控制权。

sentences.en: Now, Abdallah is still nominally president.
sentences.zh: 此时，Ahmed Abdallah 名义上依然是总统。

sentences.en: He gives speeches, receives foreign dignitaries, travels abroad to represent the Comoros at international meetings.
sentences.zh: 他发表演讲、接见外国贵宾、出国代表科摩罗参加国际会议。

sentences.en: But the man who actually holds the power is the one commanding the Presidential Guard.
sentences.zh: 但真正掌握大权的人，是那个指挥总统卫队的人。

sentences.en: And not only this. Denard has business interests across the islands.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，Bob Denard 在整个群岛都有商业利益。

sentences.en: He owns a private security firm, which holds contracts to protect South African-funded hotels that are being built on the islands.
sentences.zh: 他拥有一家私人保安公司，接下了保护岛上正在兴建的南非资助酒店的合同。

sentences.en: He operates a profitable commercial air shuttle between the Comoros and apartheid South Africa, which was heavily sanctioned at the time.
sentences.zh: 他在科摩罗和当时遭受严重制裁的种族隔离制度下的南非之间经营着一条利润丰厚的商业客运航空专线。

sentences.en: When journalists visit and ask him about his role, he is charming and unhelpful.
sentences.zh: 当记者前来采访并问及他的角色时，他风趣幽默却不提供任何有用信息。

sentences.en: He talks about his farm. He talks about his family.
sentences.zh: 他谈论他的农场。他谈论他的家庭。

sentences.en: He is a Comorian now, he says. He deflects questions about the coup, about his mercenary past and about the true nature of his authority.
sentences.zh: 他说他现在是个科摩罗人。他巧妙回避了关于政变、关于他雇佣兵过去以及关于他权力的真实本质等问题。

sentences.en: One reporter describes him as looking less like a mercenary warlord than a prosperous farmer who just so happens to own a great deal of land.
sentences.zh: 一位记者形容他看起来不像个雇佣兵军阀，倒更像个恰好拥有大量土地的富裕农场主。

sentences.en: But by 1989, the arrangement is beginning to crack.
sentences.zh: 但到了1989年，这种格局开始出现裂痕。

sentences.en: Abdallah has been president for eleven years.
sentences.zh: Ahmed Abdallah 已经当了十一年总统。

sentences.en: He is older, and he has started to believe, perhaps with some justification, that he has built enough of a constituency to govern without Denard at his side.
sentences.zh: 他年事渐高，并且开始相信（也许不无道理）自己已经建立了足够的支持基础，不再需要 Bob Denard 留在身边也能施政了。

sentences.en: He signs a decree ordering the Presidential Guard to be disarmed and integrated into the regular armed forces.
sentences.zh: 他签署了一项法令，下令缴械总统卫队并将其并入国家正规武装部队。

sentences.en: It is a direct challenge. If the decree goes through, Denard loses his military dominance over the islands.
sentences.zh: 这是直接的挑战。如果法令生效，Bob Denard 将失去对这些岛屿的军事主导权。

sentences.en: His five hundred men become soldiers in someone else's army.
sentences.zh: 他的那五百名手下将变成别人军队里的士兵。

sentences.en: He becomes just a man on a farm with a Comorian name and a complicated past.
sentences.zh: 而他将沦为一个只有科摩罗名字和复杂过去的农场普通人。

sentences.en: On the 26th of November 1989, Ahmed Abdallah is sitting in his office at the presidential palace.
sentences.zh: 1989年11月26日，Ahmed Abdallah 正坐在总统府的办公室里。

sentences.en: A shot is fired. Abdallah is dead, while Denard is wounded in the hand.
sentences.zh: 枪声响起。Ahmed Abdallah 身亡，而 Bob Denard 的手部受伤。

sentences.en: The official account is that a military officer, acting alone and without orders, entered the office and opened fire.
sentences.zh: 官方说法是一名军官擅自行动、未接命令进入办公室开枪射击。

sentences.en: Denard, loyal Bob Denard, managed to return fire but could not save the president.
sentences.zh: 而“忠诚的” Bob Denard 试图还击，但未能救下总统。

sentences.en: Now, there is plenty of evidence to suggest that this official version is a fabrication, and suspicion has long fallen on Denard.
sentences.zh: 然而，有充分的证据表明这一官方版本纯属伪造，长久以来人们一直怀疑是 Bob Denard 所为。

sentences.en: When he was eventually tried in France in 1999 for the killing, he was acquitted, for lack of direct evidence.
sentences.zh: 1999年他在法国因这起谋杀案受审时，由于缺乏直接证据，他被判无罪。

sentences.en: In any case, this time, France decides that Denard has gone too far.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这一次，法国认为 Bob Denard 做得太过了。

sentences.en: French paratroopers fly to the Comoros. They do not arrest Denard, but they make it very clear that now is the time to go.
sentences.zh: 法国伞兵飞抵科摩罗。他们没有逮捕 Bob Denard，但明确表示是他该离开的时候了。

sentences.en: He boards a plane for South Africa. He is sixty years old.
sentences.zh: 他登上了飞往南非的飞机。那年他六十岁。

sentences.en: He has children in the Comoros. He has a farm.
sentences.zh: 他在科摩罗有孩子。他有一座农场。

sentences.en: He has a name, Said Moustapha M'Hadjou, that he has been using for over a decade.
sentences.zh: 他拥有一个使用了一多年的名字：Said Moustapha M'Hadjou。

sentences.en: And he is forced to leave it all behind.
sentences.zh: 而他却不得不抛下这一切。

sentences.en: Now, if you had thought that was the end of the story for Bob Denard, no, there is more.
sentences.zh: 如果你以为这就是 Bob Denard 故事的终局，那你就错了，还有后文。

sentences.en: In 1995, aged sixty-six years old, he sets sail for the Comoros, along with thirty-three fellow mercenaries, for what will be his fourth and final coup in the Comoros Islands.
sentences.zh: 1995年，六十六岁的他与三十三名雇佣兵同伙一起乘船驶向科摩罗，去发动他在科摩罗群岛的第四次也是最后一次政变。

sentences.en: Denard and his thirty-three men take the country in a matter of hours.
sentences.zh: Bob Denard 和他的三十三名手下在短短几小时内就占领了该国。

sentences.en: The sitting president, Said Mohamed Djohar, is removed from power.
sentences.zh: 时任总统 Said Mohamed Djohar 被赶下了台。

sentences.en: But Denard hasn't reckoned on one thing.
sentences.zh: 但 Bob Denard 算漏了一件事。

sentences.en: The world has moved on. France has changed.
sentences.zh: 时代变了。法国也变了。

sentences.en: In 1978, France needed him in the Comoros, or so its politicians may have felt.
sentences.zh: 在1978年，法国在科摩罗需要他，或者至少当时的政客们是这么认为的。

sentences.en: In 1989, France wanted him out but was willing to be polite about it.
sentences.zh: 在1989年，法国想让他走，但还愿意保持礼貌。

sentences.en: In 1995, things are very different. The Cold War is over.
sentences.zh: 到了1995年，情况大不相同了。冷战已经结束。

sentences.en: The old logic of Françafrique might not have disappeared completely, but it has shifted.
sentences.zh: “法属非洲”的旧逻辑或许尚未完全消失，但已经发生了转变。

sentences.en: A French mercenary staging a coup in a small island nation is no longer a quiet intelligence asset.
sentences.zh: 一名法国雇佣兵在一个小岛国发动政变，不再是一个低调的情报资产。

sentences.en: It's an embarrassment, reported on by journalists, criticised in the European press, and impossible to deny.
sentences.zh: 它成了一件丑闻，被记者报道，遭欧洲媒体批评，而且根本无法抵赖。

sentences.en: On the 4th of October, six days after the coup, French paratroopers land on Grande Comore.
sentences.zh: 10月4日，即政变发生六天后，法国伞兵登陆大科摩罗岛。

sentences.en: The operation is called Azalée. There is no fighting.
sentences.zh: 该行动代号为“杜鹃花”（Azalée）。过程没有发生交火。

sentences.en: Denard knows what this means. The army that has, for most of his career, backed him quietly from a distance is now facing him directly.
sentences.zh: Bob Denard 明白这意味着什么。在他职业生涯的大部分时间里一直在背后默默支持他的军队，现在直接站到了他的对立面。

sentences.en: He surrenders at three in the morning on the 5th of October, and he is flown to Paris.
sentences.zh: 10月5日凌晨三点，他投降了，随后被押飞巴黎。

sentences.en: He is charged, tried and convicted of belonging to a criminal conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 他被指控、受审并因参与犯罪阴谋罪被判有罪。

sentences.en: In June 2006, he is sentenced to five years in prison.
sentences.zh: 2006年6月，他被判处五年监禁。

sentences.en: The sentence is suspended and he will serve no time.
sentences.zh: 该判决缓期执行，他无需服刑。

sentences.en: He dies on the 13th of October 2007, aged seventy-eight.
sentences.zh: 他于2007年10月13日去世，享年七十八岁。

sentences.en: And as for the Comoros Islands, it remains one of the poorest and least developed countries in the world.
sentences.zh: 至于科摩罗群岛，至今仍是世界上最贫穷、最不发达的国家之一。

sentences.en: Now, Bob Denard is not responsible for all of the woes of the Comoros Islands.
sentences.zh: 当然，Bob Denard 并不对科摩罗群岛所有的苦难负全部责任。

sentences.en: He was, after all, a product of a system, a system that tacitly supported what he was doing, as long as it was useful to its interests.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他只是一种体系的产物，只要他的所作所为对其利益有用，那个体系就会默许他的行径。

sentences.en: But it's hard to make the claim that he helped.
sentences.zh: 但很难说他提供了什么帮助。

sentences.en: Four coups, multiple presidents ousted, two presidents dead in suspicious circumstances.
sentences.zh: 四次政变，多位总统被赶下台，两位总统在可疑的状况下丧命。

sentences.en: It's hardly surprising people called him “the wolf of the Indian Ocean”.
sentences.zh: 难怪人们称他为“印度洋之狼”。

sentences.en: OK then, that is it for today's episode.
sentences.zh: 好了，今天的节目就到这里了。

sentences.en: I hope it's been an interesting one and that you've learnt something new.
sentences.zh: 希望这期节目很有趣，也希望你学到了一些新知识。

sentences.en: As always, I would love to know what you thought of this episode.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，我很想知道你对这期节目的看法。

sentences.en: Have you heard of the Comoros Islands before?
sentences.zh: 你以前听说过科摩罗群岛吗？

sentences.en: Have you ever been there? Let me know in the comments below, if you're listening to this somewhere where you can comment, and for the members among you, you can head right into our community forum, which is at community.leonardoenglish.com and get chatting away to other curious minds.
sentences.zh: 你曾去过那里吗？如果你收听节目的平台可以评论，请在下方留言告诉我；对于会员朋友们，你们可以直接进入我们的社区论坛 community.leonardoenglish.com，与其他充满好奇心的听众交流。

sentences.en: You've been listening to English Learning for Curious Minds by Leonardo English.
sentences.zh: 您收听的是由 Leonardo English 制作的 English Learning for Curious Minds。

sentences.en: I'm Alastair Budge, you stay safe, and I'll catch you in the next episode.
sentences.zh: 我是 Alastair Budge，保重身体，我们下期节目再见。
